name: Online sources
description: Find free pictures and music on Openverse and Pexels, keep who made them and their licence, use styles from a library, and hand a pack to Create your own TV channel.
author: TheMightyTRexUK
replaces_or_adds: Adds to Create your own TV channel: free backgrounds and music, with their credits, sent as a pack.

settings.label: Find a picture
settings.hint: Search for a background. Save it as the Coming up next or promo background.

settings.label: Find music
settings.hint: Search for music for promos. Pieces on sites Starboard may not fetch from are shown with a link only.

settings.label: Styles from the library
settings.hint: Styles other people made, each MIT licensed with credits. Use one to send it to Create your own TV channel.

settings.label: Your pack
settings.hint: What you saved, with its maker and licence. Send it to Create your own TV channel under Actions.

settings.label: Search
settings.hint: Pexels needs the free key in the Pexels key setting. Music comes only from Openverse.

settings.label: Pexels key
settings.hint: A free key from Pexels. Starboard sends it only to api.pexels.com. It is never shown again.

settings.label: Show items I may not be able to use
settings.hint: Off, only pictures and music free for any use are shown. On, ones for non-commercial use or with no changes are shown too, marked Check the licence.

settings.label: Pack name
settings.hint: Shown in Create your own TV channel, up to 40 characters.

actions.label: Send your pack to Create your own TV channel
actions.confirm: Put your pack, with a LICENCE.txt saying where each file came from, in the shared folder for Create your own TV channel?

actions.label: Make my pack ready to share as a style
actions.confirm: Make a zip of your pack with its LICENCE.txt and an index entry, in this plug-in's own folder? Nothing is posted or listed.

added: First draft: search Openverse and Pexels for pictures and music, keep the maker and licence, and send a pack with a LICENCE.txt to Create your own TV channel.
